Tanvir Ahsan directs Nestle’s Victory Day campaign
2019-12-16T00:00:00+06:00 | Arts & Entertainment Desk
https://www.thedailystar.net/arts-entertainment/news/tanvir-ahsan-directs-nestles-victory-day-campaign-1840738

Tanvir Ahsan started his career in advertising 12 years ago. He went on  to establish his own production house, Breathhing Space. This year, he  has directed Nestle’s Victory Day campaign. “This campaign is very close  to my heart”, says Tanvir, “The story depicts a melancholic journey of  the son of a freedom fighter, going to his funeral.” The director says that he tried his best to justify the concept through visual representation.
